title: Ask me

objectives.label: Ask when, and ask where
objectives.descriptorEN: Get the day and the place out of him with a single word each — 'Kdaj?' and 'Kje?'

objectives.label: Ask why
objectives.descriptorEN: Use 'Zakaj?' on its own to make him give up the reason he is holding back.

objectives.label: Ask without being told which word
objectives.descriptorEN: Twice he leaves a detail out and does not name the word you need — pick it yourself.

frameEN: Slavko turns up already halfway through a plan.
He has told you almost nothing about it — you'll have to get it out of him.
Today you learn to ask where, when, why and how much.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Greš z mano, vse je zmenjeno! Ampak nič ti nisem povedal. In ti nič ne vprašaš?
n1.en: You're coming with me, it's all arranged! But I haven't told you anything. And you're not going to ask?
n1.deliverySL: [bursting in, breathless with excitement] Greš z mano, vse je zmenjeno! [catching himself, sheepish] Ampak nič ti nisem povedal. [teasing, waiting] In ti nič ne vprašaš?

stallHandlers.label: Ask if you may ask him something

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Seveda! Vedno pozabim povedati, kdaj. Vprašaj me: Kdaj?
n2.en: Of course! I always forget to say when. Ask me: When?
n2.deliverySL: [warmly, open] Seveda! [self-deprecating, laughing at himself] Vedno pozabim povedati, kdaj. [handing it over, clearly] Vprašaj me: Kdaj?
n2.slowSL: Seveda … Vedno pozabim povedati … kdaj … Vprašaj me … Kdaj?
n2.deliverySlowSL: [warmly, unhurried] Seveda … [slower, sheepish] Vedno pozabim povedati … [very slowly, drawn out] kdaj … [slower, deliberately] Vprašaj me … [very slowly, enunciating every syllable] Kdaj?

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Kdaj! V nedeljo greva k babici. Ampak ti ne veš, kje je to. Kje?
n3.en: When! On Sunday the two of us are going to my grandma's. But you don't know where that is. Where?
n3.deliverySL: [pleased, echoing them] Kdaj! [answering happily] V nedeljo greva k babici. [stopping short, realising] Ampak ti ne veš, kje je to. [offering the word, clearly] Kje?
n3.slowSL: Kdaj … V nedeljo greva … k babici … Ampak ti ne veš … kje je to … Kje?
n3.deliverySlowSL: [pleased, echoing] Kdaj … [slower, warmly] V nedeljo greva … [slower] k babici … [slower, realising] Ampak ti ne veš … [very slowly, drawn out] kje je to … [very slowly, enunciating every syllable] Kje?

n4.speaker: npc
n4.sl: V Ljubljani, pri babici. Zakaj greva? Ha, skrivnost! Ampak kar poskusi: Zakaj?
n4.en: In Ljubljana, at my grandma's. Why are we going? Ha, that's a secret! But go ahead and try: Why?
n4.deliverySL: [matter-of-fact] V Ljubljani, pri babici. [teasing, singsong] Zakaj greva? Ha, skrivnost! [enjoying himself, daring them] Ampak kar poskusi: Zakaj?
n4.slowSL: V Ljubljani … pri babici … Zakaj greva? … Ha, skrivnost … Ampak kar poskusi … Zakaj?
n4.deliverySlowSL: [matter-of-fact, unhurried] V Ljubljani … [slower] pri babici … [teasing, drawn out] Zakaj greva? … [slower, mischievous] Ha, skrivnost … [slower, daring them] Ampak kar poskusi … [very slowly, enunciating every syllable] Zakaj?

n5.speaker: npc
n5.sl: No, prav! Babica je slišala tvoj glas in te hoče spoznati.
n5.en: All right, fine! Grandma heard your voice and now she wants to meet you.
n5.deliverySL: [giving in, delighted] No, prav! [warm, a little proud] Babica je slišala tvoj glas in te hoče spoznati.

n5b.speaker: npc
n5b.sl: Kaj naj ji povem o tebi? Vedno vpraša: A govoriš slovensko?
n5b.en: What should I tell her about you? She always asks: Do you speak Slovene?
n5b.deliverySL: [pleased with himself, curious] Kaj naj ji povem o tebi? [imitating her] Vedno vpraša: A govoriš slovensko?

n6.speaker: npc
n6.sl: Govorim slovensko — tako ji povem! Babica peče potico. Vedno šteje, koliko nas bo. Koliko?
n6.en: 'I speak Slovene' — that's what I'll tell her! Grandma is baking potica. She always counts how many of us there'll be. How many?
n6.deliverySL: [delighted, repeating it back] Govorim slovensko — tako ji povem! [fondly] Babica peče potico. [practical, shrugging] Vedno šteje, koliko nas bo. [offering the word, clearly] Koliko?
n6.slowSL: Govorim slovensko … tako ji povem … Babica peče potico … Vedno šteje … koliko nas bo … Koliko?
n6.deliverySlowSL: [delighted, unhurried] Govorim slovensko … [slower] tako ji povem … [slower, fondly] Babica peče potico … [slower, deliberately] Vedno šteje … [very slowly, drawn out] koliko nas bo … [very slowly, enunciating every syllable] Koliko?

n7.speaker: npc
n7.sl: Babica, dedek, jaz in ti … štirje! No, pridem pote. Spet sem nekaj pozabil.
n7.en: Grandma, grandpa, me and you … four! Right, I'll come and fetch you. I've forgotten something again.
n7.deliverySL: [counting on his claws] Babica, dedek, jaz in ti … [triumphant] štirje! [brisk, moving on] No, pridem pote. [trailing off, sheepish] Spet sem nekaj pozabil.

stallHandlers.label: He didn't say when — ask him

n8.speaker: npc
n8.sl: Zjutraj! Aha, pa glede potice: pride še teta. Babica bo spet štela.
n8.en: In the morning! Oh, and about the potica: my aunt is coming too now. Grandma will be counting again.
n8.deliverySL: [cheerful] Zjutraj! [remembering suddenly] Aha, pa glede potice: pride še teta. [amused] Babica bo spet štela.

stallHandlers.label: The number just changed — ask him

n9.speaker: npc
n9.sl: Pet! Se vidiva v nedeljo. Adijo!
n9.en: Five! See you on Sunday. Bye!
n9.deliverySL: [quick, counting again] Pet! [warm, already going] Se vidiva v nedeljo. Adijo!
